summary: First backend testing pass for Online Vaidhyaji AYUSH API. Created pytest suite covering all 16 requested flows: health check, JWT auth (register patient/doctor, duplicate, login, /me), patient profile PUT/GET, doctors list+filter+detail+404, appointment booking+listing, feed & daily-tip, reminders CRUD+404, challenges list+join, Claude Sonnet 4.5 chat + history, analytics event. 25/25 tests passed (100%) against public URL EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations) responded successfully. MongoDB _id is correctly excluded everywhere. Role-based authorization (doctor cannot edit patient profile) works. No critical, minor, or React Native issues found (backend-only test).

minor.issue: logger is referenced inside POST /api/chat/message exception handler (line 361) but defined later in the module (line 516). Works at runtime because the module fully loads before any request is served, but style-wise the logger should be initialised before route handlers.
EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like .test/.example — not a bug, just note for future tests. Tests use vaidhyaji.example.com.

action_items: Optional: move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` and `logging.basicConfig(...)` to the top of server.py so it is defined before route handlers that reference it (currently works but is fragile).
Optional: consider adding an index on users.email and doctors.specialty for scale.
Optional: consider EmailStr validation is strict; if real users use `.test` accidentally they will get a 422 — acceptable for MVP.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses async/await correctly with motor; no sync IO on the event loop.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} across all read routes and pop('_id', None) on writes.
Passwords are bcrypt hashed and never leaked in responses; JWT uses HS256 with 30d expiry.
All env vars sourced from backend/.env; no hardcoded URLs, no defaults that would mask misconfig.
All routes correctly prefixed with /api via APIRouter.
seed_data_creation: Startup seed() populates 6 doctors, 6 feed items, 3 challenges. Tests additionally create disposable TEST_ users (email prefix test_<uuid>@vaidhyaji.example.com) — not cleaned up but isolated by unique emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. When adding new backend endpoints, extend /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py and rely on `patient_ctx` / `doctor_ctx` fixtures from conftest.py which handle registration + Bearer header. Use `vaidhyaji.example.com` domain — Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs (.test/.example). Public URL comes from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. LLM chat test takes ~10-20s (Claude Sonnet 4.5) — keep timeout>=60s.
rca_of_issue: Initial test failures were caused by using `@vaidhyaji.test` domain, which python's email-validator (used by Pydantic EmailStr) rejects as a special-use/reserved TLD (RFC 6761). Switched fixtures to `@vaidhyaji.example.com` and all 25 tests pass. No backend code changes were required.
